subject: Re: Encord & Tau
text:
Hi Alyssa,

What do you mean by number of tasks? We want to start with only a
single annotator per video. Later, we will probably do multiple score
annotations per video for higher quality.
I'm currently able to annotate a 10min video in 3-5 minutes. But for more
complex tasks and higher accuracy I would expect it to take 5-10 minutes
for a 10 minute video.

We expect our volume to be quite consistent and growing. At the moment,
It's around 20 hours per week. Starting next week or the week after it
could be 40 hours per week. By the end of the year, it could be 200 hours
per week.

Best,
Alex

subject: Re: New Annotation Projects
text:
Hi Matt,

Unfortunately, if we are able to do this kind of mapping the instances vs.
the objects, we would not need the manual annotation. What we can do is
what we have done in the Youtube Videos project
(250df82a-d762-40de-a849-0d5cfee8a341), which is we identified all objects
separately. My hope was that your team is able to group them into the
correct groups identifying which instances are the same object and grouping
them. If this is not feasible, then we need to find another solution.
Please let me know asap if we need another call to discuss.

Best
Konstantina
